articleTitle: Should You Take Pre-Workout for Early Morning Classes?
imageHeadline: Pre-Workout Before 7 a.m. Class: Worth It?
imageSubtext: What to look for when you're short on sleep but need to show up
pinTitle: Should You Take Pre-Workout for Early Morning Classes? What to Know About Caffeine & Sleep
pinDescription: Pre-workout can help you get to that early class when energy is low, but the ingredient list matters—especially if you're working late nights. Learn which caffeine dose works without the jitters, what to avoid in the formula, and when it's actually helping vs. masking a bigger problem.

items.label: Look for 100–150 mg caffeine for a lift without jitters
Avoid proprietary blends—know exactly what you're taking
Morning dose clears by afternoon, less sleep disruption
